selection_rule: Minimum mean absolute anchor-relative delta error on 7 non-anchor calibration observations; retain R_combined if its MAE is within 1 second of the best. Other exact ties use fixed metric order.

forecast_policy.negative_radicand: Reject invalid transport; never silently clip
forecast_policy.justification: Fixed MSE-delta transport tests an additive excess-error floor; no slope is fitted. Policies were added before any new submission scores were revealed. Local CV intervals remain in the original readout scale.

leave_one_family_out.interpretation: The four historical non-anchor rule/recovery recipes form one correlated family; each discovery candidate forms one further family. Selection uses the remaining families only, with the same incumbent tie rule. This retrospective sensitivity is not independent confirmation and does not alter the primary selection.

interpretation: Calibration selects a hypothesis. Two subsequent outcomes assess it without retuning; all scores share the same hidden LB population. Pair counts are dependent descriptions, not independent evidence.
